_description: EntityRef: the only thing a client sends to designate an entity. Exactly two fields; no label (the server writes it), unknown fields are refused. The five kinds of the first release (the `kinds` list below; a client falls back on exactly these when the server has no GET /api/refs/kinds). Since R2 the server resolves more kinds: see kinds_response.json and kind_ids.json; `all_kinds` lists them all. persona and skill, once reserved, are active, so reserved_kinds_refused_as_kind_disabled is now empty. An RFC is a Note of type rfc, there is no EntityType::Rfc: its id is the note id.
